book.name: Mark
book.title: Yesu Keriso Tuyeghana Ahiꞌahina Mark Vivireina i Girugirumiya

content: Vihanahanapu Mai Judea* Ghooghahiyei
Pharisees* ma mai Judea* ghehauhi raugagayo* maghamaghauhi ghooghahiyei hi votaghoiya.

Yana ahi keyaka po ahi gaeba ma waira anihighuhi he rauꞌogha vaimaiha ma he dewadewa vaimaiha. Maranai maketiyei hina neꞌi yana nimahi hina oghai ma muriyai hina am. Mara maghamaghauna ghooghahi ahi raugagayo hi votaghoiya yana hina ogha da hina am. Mara emosi raugagayo tauvihanahanapuweina ma Pharisees ghehauhi Jerusalemei hi ghaꞌiraꞌi, po Yesu hi gari kwaviviroi ma hi rautanighanei. Ma hi iyaꞌiyau ma a tauvotagho egha nimahi hita ogha ma hi amꞌam.
Yamna aubaina Yesu hi riwei hipa, “Aiwa aubaina po a tauvotagho a nima mirahi ma he amꞌam? Aiwa aubaina raugagayo ghooghataiyei egha hita votaghoi?”
I paribeehi ipa, “Taumi yana rava waimorumorumi, o dewamemi po ahi ota dewadewai ma tamoghi eꞌegha! Taumi aubaimi peroveta Isaiah i amgiruma we nanaꞌarena:

content.text: Tauhi ahi raugagayo hei hanahanapuwei ma hipa Maimaituwa a raugagayo,
Yamna aubaina ahi viꞌateꞌate auwariꞌu yana egha anona.’”

content: Anima Yesu ipa, “Taumi yana Maimaituwa a raugagayo o voterei ma ghooghami ahi raugagayo oi hanahanapuwei ma o votaghoi.”
Wate i riwehi ipa, “Taumi aiwa o dewadewaiya o notai da i ahi duma! Ma Maimaituwa a raugagayo o tereriyei ma ghooghami ahi vihanahanapu o votaghoi.
Aniꞌinana emosi yana we nanaꞌarena. Moses Maimaituwa a raugagayo auwarina i amgiruma, ipa, ‘Amam ma ayom ma viꞌateꞌatehi’ ma inapa ‘Aiya amana ma ayona ina eni boꞌahi yana hina raihiragheni.’
Ma taumi oi hanahanapu, yana rava amana ma ayona purapura ina vohaguhi ma ina riwa inapa, ‘Apo ata vohagumi ma boiboghi Maimaituwa auwarina a parivainuwaghana aubaina apegha a vohagumi.’
Inapa we nanaꞌarena oi babani da ota dumaru, ma naꞌi yana eꞌegha, oi ghaꞌei da amana ma ayona egha ina vohaguhi.

Maranai we nanaꞌarena ona dewai, yana ghooghami ahi vihanahanapu o votaghoi ma Maimaituwa a raugagayo o raugahi. Marina a ririwemi, da menanaꞌarena Maimaituwa a raugagayo o raugahinei yana a tayaha i magha duma.”
Aiwa Rava e Dewai po e Miramira Maimaituwa au Matana
Yesu rava i ghoremehi po hi neꞌi auwarina ma i riwehi ipa, “Atapumi ai babani ona nonori ma anona au nuwanuwami ina raughadaghadari.
Rava yam e aniꞌaniya apegha ina dewai, po ina mira Maimaituwa au matana. Ma aiwa au nuwanuwana e maꞌamaꞌae ma gamonei e hopuhopuꞌi, yana e dewai po e miramira Maimaituwa au matana.”
Anima rava i voterehi ma i rui au numa ma a tauvotagho hi raubayadei hipa, “We marina aiwa u ampariruveruveiya yana anona aiwaꞌi?”

I paribeehi ipa, “Taumi maitemi! Auwarimi aꞌu babani anona egha ita raughadaghadari? O hanapuwei da maranai rava yam e aniꞌani, yana egha ita ruirui au nuwanuwana, ma e naenae au amoꞌamona ma e puwapuwana aharenei. Yamna apo egha ina dewai po Maimaituwa au matana ina mira.” Maranai Yesu we i yatoni,
yana i vihegha da yam atapuhi, yana ahiꞌahihi Maimaituwa au matana.
Anima wate ipa, “Rava nuwanuwanei aiwa e hopuhopuꞌi yana tauna e dewai po e miramira, Maimaituwa au matana.
We dewahi yana nuwanuwana hineninei e neneꞌi yana nuwatuhu apoꞌapoehi, yana rava egha hita tavine ma hei awaꞌawana,
danene, vihiraghena, viꞌawa danene,
amboho, viꞌamparipari, vimorumoru,
dewa waitepahinihinimayana, unura, viꞌaraꞌutu, nuwaghaeghae,
ma dewa yabayababa.
We dewaboꞌahi atapuhi rava nuwanuwanei e hopuhopuꞌi, ma e dewai po e miramira Maimaituwa au matana.”
Wavine Taumae Uputa Yesu i Vitumaghanei
Anima Yesu na dobuna i neꞌaharei ma i nae Tyre meyagaina auririvana po au numa i rui. Egha ita ghohei po rava hina hanapuwei ma wate egha emoꞌemosina po ita raugovagha.

Wavine emosi i nonori yana tauna nahidana aubaina i nae auwarina. Ma we wavinena yana egha Judeyei, au Phoenicia hi ghuni Syria dobuna autupona. Ma aruwa apoꞌapoena* natuna wavinena haburuna i taniwagei, aubaina i neꞌi yana Yesu aunaona i raupari, ma i vibaghai po aruwa apoꞌapoena natuna auwarina ita raukaiweni.

Ma i hanapuwei da na wavinena yana egha Judeyei, ma i neꞌi auwarina aubaina i riwei ipa, “Egha ita ahi po rowarowa ahi yam ouꞌou auwarihi ta aharei, yamna aubaina rowarowa ta ai ghamohi po aunaona hina amhiyauwa.”
Ma wavinena ipa, “Bada, u riwa vaimaiha ma mara gheha aniꞌam patana auwarina, ma yam vunavunahi he horuhoru yana ouꞌou he aniꞌanihi, yamna aubaina i ahi po ma vohaguꞌu.”
Anima Yesu ipa, “Moina! U riwa vaimaiha, am vitumaghana* aubaina aruwa apoꞌapoena natum auwarina a raukaiweni. Anima ma naeme am au numa.”
Anima i naeme a au numa po natuna ita inanai yana i enoꞌeno a au aniꞌeno. Ma aruwa apoꞌapoena i hopu aharei.
Yesu, Rava Tanighana Pupuna ma Gumgum i Viyawahani
Yesu, Tyre tupona i neꞌaharei po Sidon meyagaina siporinei i nae. Anima Decapolis
meyagaina hineninei i neꞌi po Galilee au hagahagana i hopu.
Ma nahidana rava ghehauhi, oroto tanighana pupuna ma egha itai babani vaimaiha, hi neiyaꞌi ma hi vibaghai da ita vodadani ma ita yawahana.
Aubaina po orotona i taravaini, ma rava hi neꞌaharehi po ahi ruwaghaꞌava ma nimagigina au tanighana i terei ma nimagigina i hovai ma menana i vodadani.
Ma i rauꞌiyau gheꞌeta au mara, ma i yavutu aharena ma ipa, “Efata!”
Na babanina anona yana ipa, “Ma wanakaiwenim!”
Ma mara emosi ravana tanighana i wanakaiweni, ma menana i vidagudagu po i vibabani vaimaiha.
Anima Yesu i raugagayowehi da egha rava ghehauhi hinai heghehi. Ma maranai i ghaꞌehi yana apoma i raimaruhi aharei ma rava maghamaghauhi, hi ririwehi da menanaꞌarena we ravana i viyawahani.

Ma maranai rava we babanina hi nonori yana hi amhuna duma ma hi riwa hipa, “We ravana ginauri maghamaghauna ahiꞌahihi e dewadewahi. Rava tanighahi puupuhi i viyawahanihi po he rautanighana ma gumgum hei babani.”

footnotes.text: ‘Rowarowa’ anona ‘mai Judea’ ma ‘ouꞌou’ anona yana ‘taumae uputa’ bo ‘egha mai Judea’. Mai Judea* hi notameehi yana tauhi hi ahi vavahagha apoma taumae uputa aubaina hipa tauhi ouꞌou.
‘Decapolis’ anona yana ‘meyagai ghaeghaehi 10’ yana Greek ponahiyei.
